headline: A storm cancels Thanksgiving's parade, Iranian drones kill two Italians in Kuwait, and EU leaders leave Brussels with no budget

leads.d: 70 mph gusts and 400+ flights cancelled on Thanksgiving. Macy's 100th parade did not march: its first weather delay in 100 years, now Saturday.
leads.h: Storm cancels the parade; ~900,000 lose power
leads.why: Holiday trips and a 100-year tradition hit

leads.d: Rheinmetall staff died at a radar site after Iranian drones were shot down; a Kuwaiti and a Pakistani hurt. Iran denies it.
leads.h: Drone debris kills two Italians in Kuwait
leads.why: Iran war now kills Western staff in the Gulf

leads.d: Leaders rejected Costa's €1.78tn plan after midnight; next try 17–18 Dec. Spain's Hernández de Cos picked to run the ECB.
leads.h: EU summit ends with no 2028–34 budget
leads.why: No 2028–34 money plan; Ukraine aid waits
